title: Dear Martin
author: Nic Stone
current_text: In February 2022, a request was filed to remove Dear Martin from South Garner High School; the school committee decided to continue using it as supplemental material in English I classes. Parents challenged the use of Dear Martin in the “culture and identity” unit of Rockwood School District’s ninth grade English classes in St. Louis County, MO. The Monett School District in Monett, Mo., removed Dear Martin from lesson plans. Columbia County Schools in Columbia County, GA, pulled Dear Martin from its recommended reading list.
